evidenceNotice: Source binding, code presence, and local execution are distinct from scientific validation, independent reproduction, publication, and production readiness.

evidenceLevels.E4: Controlled result or complete local user flow
evidenceLevels.E5: Multi-seed benchmark or comprehensive product test
evidenceLevels.E7: Independent reproduction or external reviewer confirmation
evidenceLevels.E8: Release-ready or production-ready after live credentials and external checks

portfolioIdentities.name: The BU1LD Nexus
portfolioIdentities.objective: Create a credible journey from public discovery and applications to contribution evidence and public proof.
portfolioIdentities.implemented: A TanStack and Vite product with public institutional routes, a member portal, project workflows, evidence controls, tests, release scripts, and a phased Supabase schema.
portfolioIdentities.intendedOutput: A deployable public site, member portal, and research evidence system.
limitations: Live Supabase checks and multi-role production journeys remain external release gates.
The paper analyzer is deterministic triage, not citation verification or scientific review.

portfolioIdentities.name: FinanceMeta / Finance4All Global Reach
portfolioIdentities.objective: Support a distinct visitor-to-member finance learning and contribution journey.
portfolioIdentities.implemented: A Vite React product with Supabase migrations, edge functions, member workflows, tests, release scripts, and product documentation.
portfolioIdentities.intendedOutput: A deployable finance website, member portal, programs, and editorial workflow.
limitations: Finance claims must not imply investment performance without artifact-backed evidence.
Live RLS verification and full browser journeys have not been re-established for this profile.

portfolioIdentities.name: Project Genesis
portfolioIdentities.objective: Test bounded developmental modular learning with sparse routing and continual-learning controls.
portfolioIdentities.implemented: A Python package with configurations, command-line entry points, tests, synthetic and vision loaders, smoke artifacts, and paper and audit documentation.
portfolioIdentities.intendedOutput: A reproducible research release with code, configurations, raw runs, a paper packet, and multi-seed experiments.
limitations: Smoke artifacts do not support public benchmark or novelty claims.
The declared multi-seed public benchmark campaign and independent reproduction remain incomplete.

portfolioIdentities.name: GenesisE / Genesis Economics Edition
portfolioIdentities.objective: Provide an executable lab for adaptive markets, memory, regimes, agents, counterfactuals, and economic world models.
portfolioIdentities.implemented: A dependency-free Python package with simulation modules, a CLI, benchmark and validation artifacts, documentation, and tests.
portfolioIdentities.intendedOutput: A reproducible synthetic economic simulation package with explicit validation artifacts.
limitations: All retained evidence is synthetic and internal; it does not establish real-market validity.
The broad program surface still needs stronger nearest-baseline comparisons.

researchAtlas.title: Navier–Stokes Extremal Search
researchAtlas.summary: A falsification-first search for persistent extreme flows, with matched random controls and strict numerical refinement.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The completed screen promoted no candidate and does not establish blow-up or a new extreme-flow family.

researchAtlas.title: NeuroCAD
researchAtlas.summary: A verification-first prompt-to-parametric-program workflow for editable, testable CAD artifacts.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The bounded compiler path is reproducible; open-world language, physics, and manufacturing validation remain open.

researchAtlas.title: SIDEREA
researchAtlas.summary: A human-supervised astronomical discovery pipeline combining transient triage with representation-learning research.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: Core components are tested, but prospective real-sky validation and a complete broker-to-report campaign are still required.

researchAtlas.title: Counterfactual Defect Worlds
researchAtlas.summary: Controlled defect worlds for testing whether learned systems detect, localize, and recover from broken causal structure.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The implementation is substantial, while retained studies remain mixed or negative and do not support a blanket success claim.

researchAtlas.title: Adaptive Theory Geometry
researchAtlas.summary: A closed-loop study of geometry-aware experiment selection under model misspecification and natural-data falsification.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The public atlas retains a negative/mixed selection result. Historical manuscript, illustration, and experiment identities still need reconciliation before quantitative claims can be reused.

researchAtlas.title: Causal Memory Use
researchAtlas.summary: Diagnostics for whether a model actually uses supplied memory, including controlled interventions and naturalistic transfer checks.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The controlled diagnostic is strong; a key naturalistic exchangeability assumption fails and limits transfer claims.

researchAtlas.title: Assumption Integrity Under Distribution Shift
researchAtlas.summary: Tests whether model-selection assumptions survive synthetic and natural distribution shifts.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The natural-data result is adverse and has not been independently reproduced.

researchAtlas.title: Fabric-Induced Memory
researchAtlas.summary: Structured latent memory dynamics for long-horizon sequence modeling, retrieval, decay, and persistent traces.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The retained study does not show blanket superiority; a baseline wins part of the compact benchmark.

researchAtlas.title: Gaussian Memory Fields
researchAtlas.summary: A mechanism study of differentiable memory fields, write dynamics, and long-horizon retrieval.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The primary hypothesis failed correction and the original write mechanism showed zero write-token gradient.

researchAtlas.title: NGMT Robust Memory
researchAtlas.summary: Tests whether Student-t influence weighting improves forecasting recovery beyond a Student-t output distribution.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The predefined improvement criterion was not met, and older overwritten mechanism artifacts remain compromised.

researchAtlas.title: Neural Predictive Memory Spectroscopy
researchAtlas.summary: A controlled framework for measuring memory transfer, failure profiles, and intervention sensitivity across systems.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: Synthetic transfer gates pass; accepted LoCoMo and LongMemEval confirmatory evidence is still absent.

researchAtlas.title: RIPII World Models
researchAtlas.summary: Object-state world modeling with multiresolution dynamics, conditional routing, and exact-resume evaluation.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: Controlled pilots did not advance the benchmark; conditional routing remains experimental.

researchAtlas.title: Eigen-JEPA
researchAtlas.summary: Joint-embedding predictive modeling for market representations across a real multi-asset panel.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The retained real-panel comparisons are mostly null and the paper-facing single-seed path fails the rigor gate.

researchAtlas.title: FI-JEPA
researchAtlas.summary: A macroeconomic representation-learning study comparing joint-embedding prediction with simple forecasting baselines.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The retained development study underperforms ridge and persistence baselines.

researchAtlas.title: LAM-JEPA
researchAtlas.summary: Latent-action predictive modeling for educational reasoning, tutoring, and intervention selection.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The current ARC validation loses to the supervised baseline and shows codebook collapse.

researchAtlas.title: Weather-JEPA
researchAtlas.summary: A predictive representation pipeline for weather fields, designed around staged synthetic and ERA5 validation.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The engineering path runs on synthetic data; ERA5 science and external validation have not started.

researchAtlas.title: Dynamical Representation Phase Transitions
researchAtlas.summary: A study of whether representation changes can warn when neural PDE surrogates will fail outside training regimes.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: Finite smoke runs and phase feedback exist; a scientific phase-transition result has not been established.

researchAtlas.title: Residual Event Tokenization
researchAtlas.summary: Event-centered tokenization that spends representation budget on changes and surprise in continuous streams.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: Train and evaluation paths exist, but there is no frozen paper-grade multi-seed result ledger yet.

researchAtlas.title: EPU-Ω∞
researchAtlas.summary: An efficient processing and retrieval architecture explored through a retained digit-level benchmark.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: A retained benchmark exists, while hardware and deployment claims remain untested.

researchAtlas.title: EigenFinance
researchAtlas.summary: A walk-forward research evaluator for financial hypotheses, data identity, and held-out market testing.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The evaluator is implemented, but no retained licensed real-market result supports a performance claim.

researchAtlas.title: ColorWorld
researchAtlas.summary: A learned color-grading and palette system spanning aligned grades, image/video inference, and LUT export.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The pipeline and synthetic demo run; production weights and production validation are absent.

researchAtlas.title: OLYMPUS Cognitive Architecture
researchAtlas.summary: A modular cognitive architecture and model-family foundry for testing memory, planning, and reconstruction ideas.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: Demos and software exist; current ledgers do not authorize model-family promotion or autonomous-agent claims.

researchAtlas.title: RIS Bounded Hessian Study
researchAtlas.summary: A bounded numerical study of logistic Hessian behavior and finite-difference agreement on WDBC.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The current result is numerical-only and does not support the earlier broader interpretation.

researchAtlas.title: SCDMIT
researchAtlas.summary: A large experimental codebase exploring structured dynamics and memory-inspired learning systems.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The implementation surface is larger than the retained claim-bearing evidence; no broad result is public.

researchAtlas.title: Sapir–Whorf and the Latent Tongue
researchAtlas.summary: Tools and experiments for asking how language priors shape internal representation geometry.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: A toolkit exists, while canonical real-model evidence and a frozen result ledger remain unverified.

researchAtlas.title: Speechly
researchAtlas.summary: A callable speech and language experimentation pipeline with disclosed heuristic components.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The pipeline runs, but there is no trained-checkpoint evidence ledger supporting performance claims.

researchAtlas.title: APEN / Synthica
researchAtlas.summary: A portfolio of adaptive prediction experiments and synthetic research packages with retained gate outcomes.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: APEN studies fail their gates and the Synthica packages are not independent submission-ready studies.

researchAtlas.title: Project 2424
researchAtlas.summary: A registry and quality-gate control plane for a large research-idea portfolio with explicit implementation classes.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The registry contains 2,424 records, but only a small classified subset is executable research; the portfolio remains release-rejected.

researchAtlas.title: Independent Research Foundry
researchAtlas.summary: A 64-direction screening foundry for turning broad research ideas into bounded, testable protocols.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The 64 names are screens and specifications, not 64 papers or submission-ready studies.

researchAtlas.title: ML4Science Portfolio
researchAtlas.summary: A mechanism-led scientific ML portfolio spanning eight families and four externally framed proposals.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The externally framed proposals fail advancement gates; the portfolio is not a set of validated discoveries.

researchAtlas.title: ML4Industry Portfolio
researchAtlas.summary: A 64-identity industrial ML foundry for scoping task-native studies and deployment questions.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: Most identities share scaffolding; synthetic demonstrations are not industrial proof.

researchAtlas.title: ML4SemanticIntelligence
researchAtlas.summary: A semantic-intelligence idea portfolio with diagnostics, specifications, and a small external subset.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: Most entries remain specification-only and none is currently conference-ready.

researchAtlas.title: MLInvention Foundry
researchAtlas.summary: A 64-proxy invention foundry with three promoted domains and explicit promotion gates.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The foundry is operational, but the promoted lanes do not support a positive research claim.

researchAtlas.title: Spectral Krylov-JEPA
researchAtlas.summary: A controlled study of operator-informed predictive representations and classical spectral baselines for synthetic quantum systems.
researchAtlas.publicStatus: Public baseline audit · no advantage established
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The retained audit favors simple spectral controls in important comparisons. Pipeline checks do not establish a Krylov pretraining or few-shot transfer advantage.

researchAtlas.title: Spectral JEPA
researchAtlas.summary: A proposed research direction asking whether spectral structure improves predictive representations of scientific and dynamical systems.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: This public seed record has no verified independent result. Its relationship to Spectral Krylov-JEPA is unresolved; it is not counted as another evaluated study or merged with financial Eigen-JEPA.

researchAtlas.title: Quantized Adaptive Transformers
researchAtlas.summary: A research brief on adaptation under limited numerical precision and compute, with quality, latency, and memory considered together.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The public description establishes the question, not an implemented precision policy, benchmark result, or performance improvement.

researchAtlas.title: Mahjong
researchAtlas.summary: A research direction on decision-making and uncertainty in a partially observed combinatorial game.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The ruleset, environment implementation, opponents, and evaluation protocol are not established by the public record. No solved-game or competitive-strength claim is made.

researchAtlas.title: Latent Safety & Recovery
researchAtlas.summary: An archived public research thread asking whether models can detect confident errors and recover through self-consistency.
researchAtlas.publicStatus: Archived thread · results not independently verified
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The existing public catalog marks this thread closed. A retained paper, result artifact, and reproducible comparison have not been verified for this page.

researchAtlas.title: Space JEPA 2
researchAtlas.summary: SIDEREA's shadow-only predictive-representation subproject for irregular astronomical light curves, with time-aware provenance and entity-disjoint evaluation controls.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The public implementation report has no genuine model-ready time-series input with point-in-time availability. Synthetic examples establish execution, not improved recall, calibration, workload, or discovery yield.

researchAtlas.title: IRIS Robust Recurrent Memory
researchAtlas.summary: A retained robust-memory mechanism study with mixed/negative development evidence and unresolved canonical trajectory provenance.
researchAtlas.evidenceBoundary: The learned mechanism did not clear strong-control or persistent-shift gates. Protected confirmation remains unopened while canonical raw-trajectory provenance is unresolved. This is separate from SIDEREA's astronomy work.
